name: receipt-agent
description: Reads an uploaded receipt photo or PDF and returns the merchant, date, total and category (meals, travel, accommodation, office supplies, other) it can read from it, for the employee to review and correct in expense-webapp before submitting. Each call is self-contained — one receipt in, one answer out, with nothing to continue — so it keeps no server-side conversation store: the caller holds nothing across calls, and there is no history to persist. Holds no claim data and calls no other component.
